rationale: All four units must be committed to satisfy N-1 security. Demand (260 MW) + Reserve (40 MW) = 300 MW required. Total capacity of all units is 550 MW. After losing the largest unit (g3 = 180 MW), remaining capacity is 370 MW, which exceeds the 300 MW requirement. Total cost = (400+80) + (550+100) + (700+120) + (220+60) = $2230.
